set.text: For J={i}, the author inserts “dans ce cas d’ailleurs D_J=D_i” over cancelled wording, followed by live “est” and connexe with a possible diaeresis over its first e. Formula (40) gives the map labelled kappa_i from T to pi_{U/K}^{bar L}. The following claim is that its exterior homomorphism is well determined and compatible with the indicated exterior operations. The source’s “mod autom intérieurs près” is retained without stylistic repair.

After the later barred K, a small a/u/ss body and high i dot support an omitted aussi, now retained under doubt. No independent colon precedes i.e. Both lower U_x tildes are visible; the tiny stacked upper waves remain uncertain. The arrow head and three final dots are present.
